dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: I knew it... I'm still no match for the Grand Master...

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: In terms of how much we can drink, of course! What else would it be? I can't possibly be getting into a sword fight with him!

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: What's with the Grand Master's physical makeup anyway? It's like he's guzzling plain water, not alcohol! I even deployed my own special sobriety tonic, and I still couldn't beat him...

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: See you. I really need to get more practice...

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Um, at 8th Coy, we're responsible for a variety of battlefield support operations, including emergency medical treatment.

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: But each time I treat the Grand Master's injuries, I end up questioning everything I know about first-aid.

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Either I'm taken aback by how he only managed to end up with minor injuries after a fierce battle, or I'm astonished by how someone with such severe wounds is still on his feet.

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Um, at 8th Coy, we're responsible for a variety of battlefield support operations, including technology development in certain areas.

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: We're the ones who developed tech like the ranged weapons used by 5th Coy, and the latest defensive structures...

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: Mister Albedo and Miss Lisa have also been a great help to us. Unfortunately, one of them belongs to the Investigation Team, and the other doesn't want to head a support company...

dialogues.speaker: Winfried
dialogues.text: I should also mention that among all the alchemical potions we developed together with them, the one most popular with the expeditionary force is our sobriety tonic. Our Grand Master has never used it, however.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Honorary Knight, feel like helping me get them cleaned up?

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: Oh, just some Knights of Favonius formation drills. These three overdid it last night, so I'm sobering them up.

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...And rooting out the worst offender while I'm at it, whose grand prize will be 20 laps. The expeditionary force is allowed to drink liquor, but ground rules stand for when and how much you drink.

response.speaker: Winfried
response.text: I—I only had a little bit!

response.speaker: Varka
response.text: ...Save the excuses, prove it with your feet! Show me you can nail a picture-perfect parade-ground pivot while you're plastered!
